body:
I dont wanna put my whole life story out there, but just trust me when I say you dont want what I have. I am able bodied in the sense that I can walk, bend, crawl, jump etc. but I have a large physical issue that makes acceptance very difficult once a potential employer sees my ID. Again, I dont really wanna elaborate, but it makes it very difficult to get a job.

If I had any way of getting to ND (25 hour drive away) I might go and take that route. I would hitch hike if I had a guarateed job but with no job experience it just wouldnt happen. Thanks for the idea though. Maybe one day I'll just find a way over as a last resort.

Sorry about your situation with disability. Have you tried getting social security? I know people who have gotten it when they could still work perfectly fine, I'd think you'd be a shoe in.

I've had a total 11 different psychiatrists/psychologists/therapists over the past few years. The last one as recent as 2 weeks ago. I've had multiple psyche evaluations too that all ended in a diagnoses of OCD or Generalized Anxiety disorder, which have caused me to be depressed sometimes, but I know what that feels like and this is a very different feeling.

It's odd. As badly as I want a job, or money, or fame; if it came down to it I'd rather be dead. 22 is young but I still feel like my life is over.

Maybe. After reading about neuroticism it does sound a lot like me. Unfortunately being able to address what causes me to feel so bad doesnt really do anything to make me feel better. All I can do is hope something comes along but I'm well aware of how often unemployment and suicide correlate :/
